best_idea: Queue an entity for the snapshot only when a write really changes a field, then once per fixed tick send each viewer one batch with only the changed fields and clear the marks after the build.
decision_why: The dirty-set flush with changed-field deltas and one packet per client fits Frankendom's snapshot of fight state, but the donor flushes at a variable step and kicks players for input bursts; Frankendom flushes once per fixed tick, keeps the fight state engine-only, and replaces the kick with a delaying token bucket for fight inputs.
acceptance: A test with one fighter's HP changing and three idle NPCs produces exactly one snapshot message per client per tick, containing only the changed HP field; an idle tick produces no fight message; a hit resolved on tick N appears in the flush of tick N.
